This is a map of language, not of importance. Position comes from a 2D projection of each document's text — nearby points used similar words, distant ones did not. The axes themselves carry no unit and no direction means anything. Colour and the details panel carry the real scores; this view exists to help you find and zoom into clusters, not to read distance as a number. Candidates, not conclusions — see the ranked report for the caveats on every score.
